sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Memo describing the three-story pagoda.
"It is said a precious treasure was once held within the Hirata
Estate pagoda; a three-fold tower stood upon a precipice along a
slope lined with bamboo groves.
Seems the treasure is related to shinobi techniques. The truth of it escapes me, but they called it 'blessed mist'..."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Provides a clue about the Mist Raven's Feathers that unlocks the Mist Raven after being given to the Sculptor at the Dilapidated Temple.
The upgrade material is found inside a pagoda that can only be reached by ascending the river past the Bamboo Thicket Slope Sculptor's Idol and climbing the wall hidden behind the breakable wall of bamboo near the Contact Medicine.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Full description can only be read after purchasing the item.
- Carries over to New Game Plus.
